cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a woman in traditional dress (waist ornament, neck ornament) carrying a rolled grass rain-cape on her head and a child in a sling, with a spear — a documentary ethnographic image of daily life plausible for the claimed Nigerian group.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, three-quarter profile, three-quarter length portrait of adult female. Wearing belt or waist-ornament with bunches of grass [?] at back and front, neck-ornament. Carrying rolled "rain cape" of grass on head, young child in sling on back. Rural setting.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
